properties.name: StorageEngine Rust API
properties.spec: REQUIRED FROM dynograph-foundation. reflow2 links `dynograph-storage` (default-features off), pinned at v0.12.0. This is the RocksDB-backed store beneath every DesignGraph write, and it is what makes ifc:exclusive-local-store a real requirement rather than a preference — the single-writer guarantee is that engine's exclusive lock.
